**Finding: missing (medium) — no exit/data-return obligation.**

The Term and Termination section's effects clause (para 4(c), p0019–p0022) covers only cessation of Services, license revocation, AP's cessation of use, and mutual return/destruction of Confidential Information. Nothing requires Kubient to help us transition off the Auction Platform or to return AP's data (Requests, Content and related data) in a usable format, and no transition, export, migration or "Customer Data" language exists anywhere else in the Agreement.

Redline validated (ok:true) and finding submitted: new sub-clauses (v)–(vii) inserted after p0022 giving us up to six months' transition assistance at Kubient's then-current rates, return of Customer Data in a commonly used machine-readable format within thirty days, and deletion with written certification thereafter — with 90 days of assistance available as a fallback.
